attempts.prompt:
Use case: compositing. Image1 is the sole authority for clothing, pose, hair, expression, light, and crop. Image2 provides only mascot identity and anatomy. Create a high-resolution portrait-card fusion where the human anatomy is transformed into a smooth golden-yellow compact near-round mascot head and body, featuring green-ringed black eyes and a source-matching mouth. Preserve the real source hair, specifically bareheaded receding or side-parted grey-brown hair, and real eyebrow hair. Maintain the mild image-left angle and serious closed mouth expression. Do not add prominent moustache, beard, or glasses; keep the fine primary upper-lip and nasal shadow genuinely indistinct and understated. Ensure a clearly rounded short U-shaped lower head that immediately meets a raised and broadened existing neckline, with a very short broad neck transition and minimal throat exposure. Avoid any separate yellow neck shaft, pointed V funnel, pinched collar, neck rolls, floating collar, clipping, or cream belly bib. Preserve the actual open civilian suit, dark navy or charcoal jacket, white or pale shirt collar, and dark blue or grey necktie with source-limited pale highlights. Maintain coherent front and rear collar overlap and contact shadows. Retain the complete tilted dark frame, opaque photographic backing in its actual primary color, and the attached lower-right cream note with faint indistinct upper marks and actual overlap. All solid surfaces must be opaque, with alpha only outside the complete card silhouette. Do not invent insignia, text, or accessories.
FINAL EXACT SOURCE REQUIREMENT: BAREHEADED receding/side-parted GREY-BROWN hair, real eyebrow HAIR, mild IMAGE-LEFT angle with serious CLOSED mouth. No prominent moustache, beard or glasses; fine primary upper-lip/nasal shadow genuinely indistinct and should stay understated. Dark NAVY/CHARCOAL OPEN civilian suit, WHITE/PALE shirt collar and DARK BLUE/GREY necktie with source-limited pale highlights. Primary alone controls head roll, crop and light.
Retain exact primary head angle, expression, cap shape, real hair and visible clothing/decoration areas. One compact near-round yellow mascot head with a clearly ROUNDED short chin immediately contacting raised broad collar, no V-shaped lower-face funnel or yellow shaft. Preserve actual dark solid cloth and photographic backing opacity. Tiny ambiguous features remain understated; no new badge engraving or decorations hidden behind note. Image1 exact original card; Image2 mascot identity/anatomy only.
Output alpha: genuine transparent RGBA ONLY OUTSIDE the complete original framed portrait silhouette. The photographic BACKING INSIDE the frame is a required OPAQUE surface: preserve its original background color and texture behind the character all the way to the inner frame rim. Never turn the gaps between frame and character into transparent holes or a window. Keep the actual frame angle and rim. Preserve an overlapping paper note, pin or other attachment ONLY when actually visible in this exact source; otherwise do not invent one. Do not invent a new backdrop outside the whole card. Retain source clothing, hair, headgear, lighting and crop at full generated resolution. All originally OPAQUE subject surfaces must remain FULLY OPAQUE (alpha 255): yellow head/body, hair, beard, dark or black clothing, coat lapels, collar, tie, buttons and decorations. Dark cloth is colored material, not transparent background. Never fade garment interiors into semi-transparent patches, holes, white haze or see-through fabric. Keep any genuine source outer-edge alpha falloff only at that actual exterior boundary; preserve actual source transparency rather than making the subject itself translucent.
attempts.rejection_reason: Actually viewed unchanged small primary, matching larger appearance context, full raw output, pair and white/cyan/alpha panels. Grey-brown side part, real brows, understated clean upper lip/chin, serious closed mouth, actual image-left angle, dark open suit/pale collar/dark tie and opaque complete frame/backing/note remain. Lower yellow face nevertheless slopes into a distinct pointed V at the shirt opening instead of a compact rounded short chin immediately contacting a raised broad neckline. Queue separate exact-master builtin geometry repair preserving actual hair/pose/light/clothes. Fine upper-lip shadow uncertainty is not the rejection reason; no visible internal alpha hole.
